headline: Qatar LNG shipments reach highest pace since start of US Iran war
label: NEWS
caption:
Qatari energy exports hit a significant milestone amid ongoing regional tensions. ⚡

According to Middle East Monitor, Qatar has recorded its highest pace of liquefied natural gas shipments since the start of the US Iran war.

The surge in shipments highlights ongoing efforts to maintain global energy supplies amidst regional instability.

How will this impact global energy markets in the coming weeks? 👇
